visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-speed montage of outdoor activities. A man in skydiving gear is shown screaming with his mouth wide open, wearing a white hood and goggles. A woman in a pink sweater and sunglasses is seen in a cable car and riding a luge cart. (2) The scene shifts to the Skyline Queenstown cable car. The man and woman take a selfie inside the glass cabin, smiling broadly against a backdrop of snow-capped mountains and a blue lake. (3) The characters are shown riding luge carts down a paved track on a grassy hillside. The camera uses a POV perspective from the handlebars, showing the hands of the rider in a pink sweater. (4) The scene moves to an indoor buffet restaurant. A chef's hands are seen slicing a piece of crispy roasted meat. The woman is shown eating and looking out a large window at the mountain range at dusk. (5) A series of scenic shots follow: a sunset over the lake with orange clouds, and a night view of the city lights from an elevated position. (6) The man is shown at a dark, indoor/outdoor onsen. He is shirtless in a steaming wooden hot tub, posing playfully with his hand on his chin. He is later seen eating a small dessert. (7) The final scene shows a group of people running across a green field with large boulders. The man appears in a close-up, giving a thumbs-up to the camera while wearing glasses and a black turtleneck.
